title: Monetary policy, strategy and implementation
summary: This is the ECB's research agenda index page outlining six broad research areas related to monetary policy: transmission channels, side effects of accommodative policy, forward guidance, implementation mechanics, the 'new normal' of low natural rates, and policy normalisation. The page provides no specific decisions, data points, or actionable content—merely descriptive headings of research topics the ECB studies.
key_points: Research areas listed: monetary policy transmission, side effects of accommodative policy, forward guidance, monetary policy implementation, the 'new normal' (ELB constraints), and policy normalisation
Transmission research includes heterogeneity across households/firms/banks, survey data on expectations, bank-level lending data, and climate change implications
Side effects research covers negative rate costs/benefits, asset price/wealth inequality effects, and financial stability
Forward guidance research examines theoretical determinants and empirical effectiveness
Implementation research addresses money markets, Basel III regulations, collateral framework, and climate change
The 'new normal' research focuses on the natural rate decline and approaches to avoid the effective lower bound
